It is also reforming municipal bond issuances to encourage urban infrastructure financing. With these changes, Sebi anticipates significantly mobilizing both domestic and global savings for inclusive wealth creation.

articles.title: Six listed REIT firms distribute Rs 3,234 cr in Q2 to over 5.25 lakh unitholders
articles.desc: India's six listed Real Estate Investment Trusts distributed Rs 3,234 crore to over 5.25 lakh unitholders. Since their inception, these REITs have distributed over Rs 38,000 crore collectively to investors. The total gross Assets Under Management for the sector exceeded Rs 3.30 lakh crore recently. The strong demand for office space contributed to healthy occupancy and rental collections.

articles.title: Keystone Realtors to launch Rs 5,000 cr worth housing properties in MMR by Mar: CMD
articles.desc: Keystone Realtors is set to unveil residential developments valued at Rs 5,000 crore across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region by next March. With sales bookings hitting Rs 2,000 crore in the first half of the fiscal year, the company is optimistic about achieving targets, particularly with anticipated festive demand boosting sales. Their robust project pipeline includes plans worth Rs 8,000 crore, having already developed over 30 million square feet.

articles.title: Signature Global acquires 10-acre land parcels in Gurugram to build realty projects
articles.desc: Signature Global has successfully acquired two land parcels in Sohna, Gurugram, covering around 10 acres as part of its initiative to bolster its project portfolio. This strategic move complements the company’s focus on expanding its footprint in lucrative regions. Recently, Signature Global also secured a substantial land bid in Raigad, Maharashtra, signaling its ambitions beyond the Delhi-NCR area.

articles.title: Walmart raises its outlook for the year for the 3rd time after a solid quarter
articles.desc: Walmart reported robust third-quarter sales figures, reflecting ongoing consumer demand for affordable shopping solutions. The retailer saw a significant surge in e-commerce sales, rising by 23%. With an emphasis on digital services and advertising, Walmart has effectively preserved its competitive advantage amid growing inflation concerns. Nonetheless, analysts express a cautious perspective regarding future sales forecasts, projecting a total sales growth of 4.9% to 5.2% for the fiscal year.

articles.title: Palo Alto's raised sales forecast powers rally in cybersecurity stocks
articles.desc: Palo Alto Networks recently announced its acquisition of AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion. The company raised its annual forecast, which positively influenced various cybersecurity stocks. Investors are increasingly focused on cybersecurity due to the rise of AI-enabled cyberattacks and recent technology outages. Shares of other cybersecurity firms have surged in response to Palo Alto's optimistic outlook. The Nasdaq composite also enjoyed gains ahead of Anthropic's market debut.

articles.title: India needs $430 billion in exports in five months to meet FY27 target: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India requires approximately USD 430 billion in exports from November to March to meet its ambitious target. By the end of October, the country had achieved 57 percent of its export goal for 2026-27. October exports reached an all-time high of nearly USD 90 billion, which reflects substantial growth. Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal proposed a target of USD 1 trillion for this fiscal year.

articles.title: Nasdaq rallies as record Anthropic IPO revives AI stocks

Pricing higher than expected, the IPO raked in impressive funds and valuations, positively impacting tech peers like Amazon and Alphabet. Despite some investor caution, notable gains were seen in firms like Palo Alto Networks. Overall, the market displayed a varied performance, reflecting ongoing uncertainties over the Federal Reserve's future rate strategies.

A significant number of investors are concerned about the absence of artificial intelligence-related investment options available. Increased interest in healthcare and shifts toward defensive sectors have been noted, reflecting changing priorities among investors. Despite concerns over potential risks, half of the fund managers predict a soft landing for the global economy.

They seek collaboration in sectors such as automotive, aerospace, and agriculture. The discussions took place during the recent India-Italy Joint Commission for Economic Cooperation meeting in Rome. Participants highlighted the importance of investment partnerships and technology sharing for successful outcomes. Both countries aim to integrate into global value chains effectively.

articles.title: Stock rally keeps rupee upbeat, traders eye exporters for fresh fuel
articles.desc: The Indian rupee has surged to its highest value in seven months, driven by a notable uptick in equity markets. A 1% rise in the Nifty 50 index has fostered optimism among traders and analysts alike. As the foreign exchange market's corporate activities demonstrate mixed reactions from exporters and importers, improved participation from exporters may further enhance the rupee's strength.

articles.title: India-US FTA could strengthen aerospace partnerships, boost business opportunities: Gautam Singhania
articles.desc: Gautam Singhania emphasized the potential benefits of the proposed India-US Free Trade Agreement for aerospace partnerships. He noted that his company, Raymond Aerospace, has long-standing relationships with American firms. The 23rd Indo-US Economic Summit facilitated networking opportunities to strengthen commercial ties between both nations. Various industry representatives explored collaboration possibilities that could benefit both sides. Increased cooperation in aerospace could lead to growth in business opportunities through this trade agreement.

articles.title: Intuit deepens its investment in India with the opening of its new Bengaluru campus
articles.desc: The new two-tower Bengaluru campus is now home to Intuit’s second-largest engineering center, reflecting its continued investment in India as a top innovation hub. It brings together teams across core product, platform, and AI capabilities that serve tens of millions of customers worldwide.

articles.title: Tiger-backed Razorpay set to file for India IPO as early as next week
articles.desc: Tiger Global-backed Razorpay is preparing to file its IPO papers in India as early as next week, with investor roadshows expected to follow immediately. The Bengaluru-based fintech firm could launch its public offering as early as February, aiming to raise up to $600 million through a mix of fresh and secondary share sales.

articles.title: FCNR-related costs and benefits yet to fully play out for banks: Report
articles.desc: Foreign Currency Non-Resident deposits are expected to significantly influence the performance of Indian banks. The benefits and costs associated with these deposits have not fully materialized for financial institutions. Banks exhibiting a strong position in fixed-rate FCNR deposits may manage rising funding costs more effectively. Variations in loan growth and deposit composition among banks could lead to different performance outcomes.

articles.title: Jaishankar meets senior Japanese leaders; discusses deeper strategic, economic ties
articles.desc: S Jaishankar met with key Japanese leaders in Tokyo to discuss strengthening bilateral cooperation. The focus was on enhancing strategic, economic, and energy security ties between India and Japan. In addition, Jaishankar will co-chair the upcoming India-Japan 2+2 Foreign and Defence Ministers' Dialogue. This dialogue aims to review various aspects of defense cooperation and relations. Both nations maintain a Special Strategic and Global Partnership encompassing multiple areas of collaboration.

Early trading sessions showed minor fluctuations in the benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield. Meanwhile, US Treasury yields stabilized after recent volatility. Crude oil prices held firm, shaped by global supply and demand trends. Anticipation grows in Indian markets for a possible rate hike from the Reserve Bank of India in December.

articles.title: Elon Musk says he feels 'pretty foolish' for failed US election spending
articles.desc: World's richest man Elon Musk said Wednesday he felt "pretty foolish" for donating nearly half a billion dollars to failed campaigns in recent US midterm elections, backing right-wing Republicans in races that were largely won by Democrats. Among the candidates he backed most strongly was Texas Senate candidate Ken Paxton, with Musk contributing an estimated $220 million to the Republican, only for the race to be won by James Talarico, a 37-year-old Democrat.

articles.desc: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told a House of Representatives Homeland Security Committee hearing on worldwide threats Wednesday that there is so far no indication that the tech outages are related. But Clayton said the speed and level of capability of computer systems are "increasing substantially," so legacy computer systems and equipment that already were old are aging much more quickly.

articles.title: Arizona says it is investigating OpenAI, other firms over possible rogue agents
articles.desc: The state of Arizona has opened a criminal investigation into OpenAI and other AI companies relating to the "apparent infiltration of banks by rogue AI agents," Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes said Wednesday. A criminal investigation does not necessarily mean charges will be brought. Mayes said her office was investigating whether Arizona state law was being violated on an ongoing basis.
